editorial.headline: Tech Leadership Drives Uneven Market Gains
editorial.opening_summary: S&P 500 +1.49% at the close. Nasdaq +2.26% versus S&P 500 +1.49%, a +0.77 percentage-point spread.
watchlist: Participation above 7/11 advancing sector ETFs would broaden the next-session reading; lower participation would weaken it.
Use 4.96% as the ten-year closing reference; test whether a move above it coincides with weaker technology relative returns.
Compare next-session participation with today’s 8/9 advancing technology names; fewer advancers would narrow leadership.

regime.observed: RSP +0.56% versus SPY +1.55%; equal weight minus cap weight -0.99 percentage points.
regime.interpretation: Cap-weighted outperformance points to concentrated leadership rather than broad-based index gains.

sector_leadership.observed: Comm. Services (XLC) +3.89% ranked highest; Energy (XLE) -2.30% ranked lowest, separated by 6.19 percentage points.
sector_leadership.interpretation: The spread between top and bottom sectors highlights relative leadership rather than a uniform market advance.
